name: activity-snapshot-then-delta
description: an ACTIVITY_SNAPSHOT creates the activity message and an ACTIVITY_DELTA patches its content in place
kill: drop the `jsonpatch.applyPatch` call in the ACTIVITY_DELTA branch, leaving the snapshot's content in place

dotnet.intentional: The .NET client has no activity reducer: ACTIVITY_SNAPSHOT and ACTIVITY_DELTA reach a consumer only as RawRepresentation on a pass-through update, so no activity-role message is materialised and no patch is applied. Alignment tracked separately.
